title: Internal Metabolite Extraction for Targeted and Untargeted Metabolomics
author: Gretchen Swarr
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.64hhgt6

steps.title: Store filters frozen
steps.instruction: Keep all filters at –80 °C until they are needed for extraction.

steps.title: Prepare workspace and tools
steps.instruction: Use a combusted aluminum‑foil surface for weighing and cutting; rinse tweezers and scissors (especially interior edges) with methanol before starting.

steps.title: Cut filter into small pieces
steps.instruction: Cut each filter into pieces small enough to stack on the bottom of an 8 mL glass vial; perform this step quickly to avoid degradation.

steps.title: Add solvent and sonicate
steps.instruction: Place the filter pieces in an 8 mL glass vial, add extraction solvent (as defined later), and sonicate the vial for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer solvent to Eppendorf tubes
steps.instruction: Using a combusted Pasteur pipette, pipette the extraction solvent from the vial into two 2 mL Eppendorf tubes, leaving the filter behind (total solvent per sample will be 2.5 mL).

steps.title: Rinse filter three times
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL fresh extraction solvent to the glass vial, vortex, and transfer the rinse to the Eppendorf tubes; repeat this rinse three times, collecting a total of 2.5 mL solvent per sample.

steps.title: Centrifuge extracts
steps.instruction: Spin the Eppendorf tubes at 20,000 × g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant and neutralize
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant into new, combusted 8 mL glass vials without disturbing the pellet; add 51.2 µL of 6 M ammonium hydroxide to neutralize each sample.

steps.title: Vacufuge spin‑down (partial dry)
steps.instruction: Place the vials in a Vacufuge and spin until the liquid is reduced but not completely dry; duration depends on the remaining volume.

steps.title: Reconstitute with deuterated mix
steps.instruction: Bring each sample up to 500 µL with a 0.05 µg/mL deuterated injection mix (D₂‑biotin, D₆‑succinic acid, D₄‑cholic acid, D₇‑indole‑3‑acetic acid, and ¹³C‑phenylalanine). Note: volume may be adjusted for particular samples.

steps.title: Aliquot and dry to near dryness
steps.instruction: Transfer 250 µL of the solution to a new amber vial and dry in the Vacufuge to near dryness only.

steps.title: Adjust pH to 2
steps.instruction: Add approximately 500 µL of 0.01 M HCl to bring the sample volume to ~500 µL and lower the pH to 2.

steps.title: PPL cartridge cleanup
steps.instruction: Process the acidified sample through a 50 mg/1 cc PPL cartridge as described.

substeps.instruction: Pass one cartridge volume of 100 % methanol through the cartridge (collect waste methanol in an old test tube placed in the filtration manifold).
Turn on the vacuum pump; pre‑rinse the cartridge with one cartridge volume of 0.01 M HCl.
Load the acidified sample onto the cartridge and pull through at a flow rate < 40 mL min⁻¹.
Rinse the cartridge with one cartridge volume of 0.01 M HCl.
Dry the cartridge for about 5 minutes.
Place a fresh glass test tube under the cartridge outlet.
Elute the retained analytes with one cartridge volume of 100 % methanol; keep flow rate < 2 mL min⁻¹ (gravity is sufficient).
Collect the eluate in an 8 mL amber glass vial using a Pasteur pipette.

steps.title: Final concentration and reconstitution
steps.instruction: Vacufuge the eluate to almost dryness, then bring the residue up to 250 µL with a 95:5 water:acetonitrile solution (add acetonitrile first if solubility is poor).

steps.title: Aliquot for FT‑ICR analysis
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the reconstituted sample to a glass insert placed in an LC vial for FT analysis.

steps.title: Prepare pooled QC sample
steps.instruction: Add 45 µL of each individual sample to a single LC vial (without insert) and vortex; run this pooled QC as a partial loop between blanks and samples and as a full loop approximately every six samples. If volume permits, keep the pool in the 2 mL vial; otherwise, aliquot 200 µL into multiple insert‑containing vials.

steps.title: Extract remaining filter pieces
steps.instruction: Place the filter fragments in an amber 8 mL glass vial, add 1000 µL ice‑cold 40:40:20 acetonitrile:methanol:water + 0.1 M formic acid using a glass syringe, spike with 25 µL of a 1 µg/mL deuterated‑standard stock solution, and vortex gently until the pieces are fully covered and the solvent contacts both sides of each fragment.
